cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got dinner and your departure organized. Choose now: I stir your parents' gravy or drive you to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you put dinner on a timer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The timer won't stir it. But I'm flexible about the order: which job do you want first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Gravy. I'll book a taxi. Just bring my suitcase downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, transport sorted. I'll fit in the case if that's your priority. Shall I carry it now and let the gravy lump, or keep stirring while you bring it down?

heightening.evidence: A5 turns the smaller favor left by the taxi plan into the same urgent priority game.

specificity.evidence: A1 dinner and departure and B4 suitcase give concrete simultaneous tasks.
